description.p: Caret is a terminal built with GTK 4 and libadwaita. Its text is drawn by the GPU, pixel for pixel at any display scale.

ul.li: Tabs with an overview, and new tabs and windows in the folder of the current one
Search through the history, selection by word or line, and addresses opened with Ctrl and a click
Mouse reporting, bracketed paste, true colour, and underline styles
The desktop's monospace font and colour scheme, or ones of its own

description.p: Tangent is now called Caret. Its settings start from the defaults.

ul.li: New tabs open in the folder of the current one, and in its Toolbox or Distrobox container, where the shell reports them
Tabs show a running command, and a finished one or a notification in a tab that is not in view; Ctrl+Shift+Up and Down scroll between prompts
Tabs can be renamed from their context menu
The title bar can be hidden, and is in full screen
Selecting with the mouse scrolls past the edge; Select All and Deselect
The link under the pointer is underlined, and one a program broke into lines is followed
Symbols the font joins, such as -> and !=, are drawn joined, and a setting turns features of the font on and off
Settings for a command to run instead of the shell and for scrolling on output and on keystroke
Pasting several lines asks first where they would run, and programs can be kept from notifying and from copying
